title: 20 Greece Wedding Venues From the Islands to Athens
audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
notes: NEW venue guide (not a refresh, not a traditions article). Model: the precedent is content/posts/lake-como-villa-wedding-exclusive-use): every venue verified on its own official site; house rules a venue does not publish written as 'Not published' with one line per section that the Wedded Advisor confirms them in writing, no VERIFY marker, listed on a booking checklist; no prices or fees.

OVERLAP RISK: the live hub /destinations/europe/greece is titled 'Greece Wedding Venues: Curated Island & Mainland Luxury'. SEO pulls its rankings for 'greece wedding venues' and variants; if it ranks, this guide is the editorial companion (venues by region, like-for-like comparison, practical sections), links the hub prominently, and the run report recommends how the two split the keyword. Nothing on the live site changes. Also link /venue/rocabella-santorini-hotel-spa if that venue is on the list, and /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once.

AUTHORITY RULE (content-system/brand/voice-guide.md 'Write with authority'): no research talk in the copy (what we could or couldn't find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; what the internet says; myths sections; 'you will often read'). Customs without a strong source are written as living practice in a confident voice ('Many couples...'), never with a meaning or origin stated as fact. 'Often told' at most once per post, never 'it is often told that'. No hedge stacking: cite a source once by link; date legal and travel facts once per section. Source gaps go in the run report only. No per-line source credits (never 'Britannica describes', 'the museum holds', 'the study records'). No myth-busting lines ('you will often read', 'confident dates').

Venue selection (brief sets 20): spread across Santorini, Mykonos and other Cyclades; Crete; Corfu and the Ionian; Rhodes and the Dodecanese; the Peloponnese; Athens and the Athens Riviera. Mix of hotels and resorts, private villas offering exclusive use, and historic or estate venues. Inclusion rule: the venue's own official site says it hosts weddings. Unconfirmable candidates are swapped; do not pad to 20 (if fewer qualify, the title count changes and the person is told).

Each venue entry, from official pages only: location and setting; ceremony options (on-site ceremony, chapel, symbolic or legal only where the venue says); capacity where published; exclusive use where offered; guest rooms where published; one standout detail. House rules (curfew, minimum nights, music) as 'Not published' plus the Advisor line.

Supporting sections (short, sourced): comparing venues like for like; getting there (airports, ferries, transfers) as practical guidance; season and wind (the meltemi) only as an official or tourism source states it; legal in brief (civil, Orthodox, symbolic) from the Embassy Athens and Smartraveller facts in content/posts/greek-wedding-traditions/03-source-pack*.json, re-checked; Smartraveller Greece checked live.

Sources: venues' official websites and wedding pages, visitgreece.gr (Greek National Tourism Organisation), Smartraveller, the Australian Embassy Athens. Never competitor wedding sites, directories, vendor blogs, review sites or Wikipedia. No reuse of competitor wording or images.

Links: /destinations/europe/greece (hub, prominent), /venue/rocabella-santorini-hotel-spa if listed, /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions, destination packages pages from the link map if natural, /wonderland-concierge, /magazine. UTMs: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=greece-wedding-venues&utm_content=primary|secondary.

Images: placeholders only; every venue image must be licensed or from a venue press kit with permission (permission emails drafted only, never sent); venue images are never AI; competitor images reference-only.

Speed: Apify web-fetch (parallel) and DataForSEO. Fact-check as 3 parallel batches (A: Cyclades; B: Crete, Dodecanese, Ionian; C: Athens, Riviera, Peloponnese and practical sections), 15 min HARD by the clock, start no new reads after the limit, save after every 3 facts, separate scratch folders; self_qa.confidence a number; must_include_coverage objects with covered_by arrays; never retry a declined call.
Headings must not contain pasted keywords in brackets.
Do not use 'from first idea to the last dance' or 'last dance'; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md; no Wedded Privileges or inclusions beyond brand facts.

Person's standards: exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways; no prices or amounts; venue names allowed (it is a venue guide), no other vendor names; business details deferred; Australian English; no em dashes.
